title: Ledger rows: table and batch ingest

story.i_want_to: deliver my shadow-ledger rows to loopctl in batches
story.so_that: gate outcomes, selection quality and phase timings from every machine are answerable from one place

rationale: loopctl#1014: the 2026-10-28 audit answered these questions by ssh'ing into four machines. Machine-called endpoint, exempt from the MCP-tool rule like the change-events webhook.

acceptance_criteria.description: A new tenant-scoped table chg_ledger_rows (RLS enabled, tenant_id never cast) stores one row per delivered ledger row: source_id, repo, host, kind, sha, at (from at_ms), verdict, ms, the row's raw JSON, and row_hash (sha256 of the raw row as delivered). A unique index on (tenant_id, source_id, host, row_hash) makes delivery idempotent.

POST /api/v1/chg_ledger/:source_id takes {rows: [...]} of at most @max_ledger_batch rows under @max_ledger_body_bytes, authenticated exactly as POST /api/v1/change_events/:source_id (same HMAC, window, identical 401, revoked-root check). The answer is 200 {inserted, duplicates, rejected: [{index, reason}]}; a row that fails validation is rejected by index and never fails the batch.

kind is open: chg and gate rows are validated against the shadow Row shape (v, kind, repo, host, sha, at_ms, verdict in pass|fail|error|skipped, ms); review_round, flaky and runner rows need only v, kind, repo, host, at_ms; any other kind is stored with those fields so chg can add kinds without a loopctl release.
A row whose repo is not the source's repo is rejected with reason repo_mismatch, so one source's secret cannot write another repository's ledger.

A nightly Oban cron deletes rows older than 180 days in bounded batches, and the request path makes no outbound call. The operation/2 spec documents the 401, the batch and body caps (one module attribute each, shared by guard and spec), and the rejected-row reasons.
Tenant isolation: tenant A's source cannot write or read tenant B's rows.

test_cases.name: a batch inserts and a redelivery is all duplicates
steps: post a signed batch of a chg row and a gate row

test_cases.name: one bad row does not fail the batch
steps: post a batch with a valid row, a row missing sha, and a row for another repo
expected_results: rejected names index 1 invalid_row and index 2 repo_mismatch

test_cases.name: refusals share the 401
steps: post to an unknown source id
expected_results: identical 401 bodies for the first two

test_cases.name: unknown kind is stored
steps: post a row of kind cache_sample

test_cases.name: tenant isolation
preconditions: sources in tenants A and B
expected_results: B sees none of A's rows

technical_notes: Signature verification, the revoked-root check and the 401 are the change-events plug path; reuse it, never a second HMAC implementation.
Insert with insert_all on_conflict: :nothing inside with_tenant; count inserted from the returned rows.
The shadow Row type is chg cli/src/shadow.rs; the field list is loopctl#1014's issue body.
